description: Use this when the user names or describes a Pokémon card and wants to identify it or see its price, value, or sold comps. Finds Pokémon cards the way the pokefocus.com search box does, best match first. Each card has its id, TCGplayer market price, 30-day raw and PSA 10 verified sold medians and sale counts, image, and card page. When match is partial, no card matched every word and the results leave out ignoredTerms, so they may be a different card. Not for sealed products.

q.description: Card name, number ("173/165", "GG35"), set name or code, rarity, or a mix, as in the pokefocus.com search box.

name: search_cards

capturedAt.description: When PokeFocus answered; market.asOf is when a price was refreshed.

marketPrice.description: TCGplayer market price (Near Mint), US dollars.

psa10SalesMedian30d.description: Median verified PSA 10 sale over 30 days, US dollars.

rawSalesMedian30d.description: Median verified raw sale over 30 days, US dollars.

ignoredTerms.description: Words a partial match left out.

match.description: exact: the cards match every word. corrected: they match after a typo or nickname was fixed (see matchedQuery). partial: no card matched every word, so these leave out ignoredTerms and may be a different card; confirm the name, number, and set before using a price.

matchedQuery.description: The query as PokeFocus read and matched it.

title: Search Pokémon cards
